title: Shopify Expert
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Shopify Expert to join our team in Tirupur. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Shopify store development, customization, and optimization, along with a strong understanding of D2C ecommerce ecosystems.

This role requires both technical proficiency and strong communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and clients effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain Shopify stores using Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Implement custom Shopify themes and modify existing themes based on project requirements
* Integrate third-party applications and tools from the Shopify App Store
* Optimize store performance, speed, and conversion rates
* Work on D2C ecommerce projects, ensuring seamless user experience and customer journeys
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Shopify stores
* Collaborate with design, marketing, and project management teams
* Stay updated with Shopify platform updates, new features, and ecommerce trends

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven experience working with Shopify (mandatory)
* Strong knowledge of **Shopify Liquid templating language**
* Hands-on experience with **Shopify App Store integrations and custom app configurations**
* Solid understanding of **D2C ecommerce business models**
* Proficiency in frontend technologies: **HTML, CSS, JavaScript**
* Experience in theme customization and Shopify store setup
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
* **Excellent communication skills** (written and verbal)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on international ecommerce brands
* Understanding of CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) principles
* Familiarity with performance optimization and SEO best practices in Shopify
* Experience with Shopify Plus (optional but preferred)

**Work Environment**

* On-site role based in Tirupur
* Collaborative and fast-paced agency environment
* Opportunity to work on global ecommerce projects

**Why Join Us**

* Work with a growing ecommerce-focused organization
* Exposure to international D2C brands and projects
* Opportunity to build deep expertise in Shopify and ecommerce

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Experience in handling multiple shopify Stores?
* No. of Shopify Website Managed for international clients.

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Language:

* Fluent English (Required)

Work Location: In person
